purpose: Construct a fixed physical noise-measurement frame invariant to arbitrary syndrome eigenvector gauge, without changing source research owner or native financial authority.
gauge_variants: identity and three deterministic seeded complex unitaries, seeds 1, 7, 257; no seed search
constructive_method: Deterministic, twice-reorthogonalized Gram-Schmidt on recovery syndrome coordinate columns indexed by physical computational basis, first logical output; fixed numerical threshold; rotate syndrome states and recovery; construct square-root-free normalized informationally complete frame by Cholesky; verify physical Kraus completeness.

criteria.gauge_response_max_abs: <= 2e-8 across all fixed rotations and both fixtures
criteria.identifiability: same available rank and disclosed indistinguishable pairs as independent owner; no removed hypotheses
criteria.negative_control: source uncorrected generic frame must demonstrably vary under at least one registered nontrivial gauge rotation
criteria.fresh_process: two independently invoked processes using same pinned owner requirements plus SOURCE_HEAD, sha1/sha256, numerical receipts and full failure retention
criteria.fail_closed: invalid dimensions, incomplete gauge rank, nonphysical probabilities and source-identity drift refuse

permitted_scope: Read-only alternative research module, tests and workflow, separate PR; no changes to existing QEC owner code, source/ledger/account/keys/queues, no transactions or release.
limitations: Gauge-invariant numerical design is NOT physical quantum hardware qualification, instrument economy, new algorithm, confirmed causally faster invention, viable customer demand, native profit or the US$3B T365 target.
stopping_rule: Run two fixed real fixtures and all 609 pairs with three frozen rotations. Preserve all failures; do not retune seeds, thresholds or cases to win.
